title: Zoho CRM Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs & What's Included
summary: Zoho CRM pricing structures determine your monthly software costs based on specific feature requirements and team size.
body_markdown:
## Manage hidden Zoho CRM scaling costs


Zoho CRM enforces hard technical ceilings on data processing and storage that require you to purchase higher-tier licenses or add-on credits to maintain operational continuity.


### API call limits and the cost of integrations


A 24-hour rolling window restricts the total number of requests allowed between Zoho CRM and external tools.


While Salesforce Starter has a fixed daily limit per org that scales with user count, Zoho’s shared pool often requires you to purchase additional 10-unit API packs to prevent integration failures.


Every time a separate application polls Zoho for an update, it consumes a portion of a daily allowance. Once exhausted, integrations break until the next reset or a "top-up" is purchased.


Activepieces solves this by using a single Webhook. This is a real-time notification sent from Zoho to trigger a sequence of events across other platforms.


If the specific connector you need to reduce these calls is missing, Activepieces allows you to generate the integration with AI and add it to your instance, contributing to a catalogue where roughly 60% of integrations are community-contributed.


This architecture ensures that one outgoing signal from Zoho can update multiple destinations without requiring those apps to ping Zoho’s API repeatedly.


You will face a recurring overhead if you're using Gemini 3.8 Flash to process high-volume customer sentiment data. Every analyzed record consumes a portion of a daily allowance.


### Zoho CRM workflow task credits and overage fees


Automated actions within the system are governed by task credits. These are consumed every time a workflow rule triggers an update or sends a notification.


Unlike HubSpot Sales Hub, which allows for broader automation triggers on its entry-level tiers, Zoho CRM restricts the number of "Connected Workflows" that can bridge different modules.


When you rely on Zoho’s native workflow rules, a sudden marketing success can result in a massive bill for "overage" tasks.


Activepieces manages these spikes through credit-based AI billing that includes cost caps per team, ensuring that high-volume data processing remains within a predictable budget.


This allows builders to deploy complex logic without the risk of uncapped overage fees, as the platform meters usage through a transparent credit system.


MoneyGram and Moneypenny run these high-volume environments in production without the tax on complexity that per-task billing models impose.


Scaling past these constraints involves one of four technical triggers:


1. Exceeding 100,000 records, which triggers a mandatory upgrade to the enterprise pricing tier.
2. Requiring more than 2 ‘Connected Workflows’ to sync data between disparate departments.
3. Needing custom modules to track industry-specific data, a feature locked behind the Enterprise tier.
4. Hitting the 5GB base storage limit, so the system will automatically reject any incoming data uploads.


### Zoho CRM data storage and attachment limits


The base storage allocation covers both the relational database and physical file attachments. A high volume of PDF contracts can prevent the creation of new lead records.


Expanding this capacity requires purchasing additional gigabytes in monthly increments. This turns a one-time licensing cost into a variable monthly utility bill.


Activepieces mitigates this by intercepting file uploads via the CRM's API and immediately routing them to more affordable cloud storage providers.


Activepieces includes 739 integrations in its open-source monorepo, allowing you to connect Zoho to specialized storage providers that don't carry the same per-gigabyte premium as CRM native storage, effectively lowering the long-term cost of data retention.


This keeps the CRM database light while ensuring files are stored in a high-capacity environment where the cost per gigabyte is significantly lower.
